title: Eggplant Parmesan Crumble
description: A fusion of Italian and Egyptian flavors, this eggplant parmesan crumble is a twist on the classic dish with a crunchy topping.
instructions: Brush the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt.
Bake the eggplant slices in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
In a bowl, combine the ricotta cheese and parmesan cheese.
Spoon a layer of tomato sauce into the bottom of a baking dish.
Arrange a layer of eggplant slices on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta mixture over the eggplant.
Sprinkle half of the crumble mixture over the ricotta.
Repeat the layers, starting with the eggplant, then the sauce, then the ricotta, and finally the crumble.
Top the crumble with the remaining parmesan cheese.
Bake the cassrole for 25-30 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped basil and serve hot.
